text: For a small teaching graph, recomputing affinities from original edges is a clear implementation. After each merge, update membership and sizes, then rebuild the candidate list. One blocked candidate does not justify stopping; another legal pair may still exist. Stop at K, or when every positive-affinity candidate is illegal. Our reference rejects invalid sizes and never forces a zero-affinity merge just to reach K.

cues.en: For a small teaching graph, recomputing affinities from original edges is a clear implementation.
cues.zh: 对于教学小图，从原始边重新计算亲和度是一种清晰的实现方式。

cues.en: After each merge, update membership and sizes, then rebuild the candidate list.
cues.zh: 每次合并后，更新成员关系和大小，再重建候选列表。

cues.en: One blocked candidate does not justify stopping; another legal pair may still exist.
cues.zh: 一个候选被容量阻止，并不意味着可以停止；可能还有其他合法簇对。

cues.en: Stop at K, or when every positive-affinity candidate is illegal.
cues.zh: 达到 K 时停止，或者在所有正亲和度候选都不合法时停止。

cues.en: Our reference rejects invalid sizes and never forces a zero-affinity merge just to reach K.
cues.zh: 参考实现拒绝无效大小，也不会为了凑够 K 而强行合并零亲和度簇对。
